component.name: PDFchemy Tools
component.summary: Local-First Emergency Document Utility Built For The People

description.p: PDFchemy Tools is a 100% offline, privacy-first emergency document utility built for the people. All PDF operations execute locally on your machine with zero cloud uploads and zero telemetry.

Developer Manifesto: "Lifetime of updates until I personally die and free of charge; and all you have to do is make a solid valid request and it will be done and implemented; cuz it's from the people to the people..." — Andrei Ioan Cucoș (John), Developer

ul.li: Visual Page Studio: Rearrange, rotate, delete, and duplicate pages with responsive visual thumbnail cards.
Smart Target Compressor: Optimize DPI and JPEG quality to guarantee your document fits under email or portal size budgets (e.g. under 2MB).
Images ⇄ PDF Studio: Compile collections of photos or receipts into a PDF, or batch-extract all pages as high-res PNG images.
Multi-Core Batch Queue: Process 50+ PDFs simultaneously across all CPU cores.
Reflow Reader: Distraction-free reading with typography scaling and dark/sepia themes.
Document Security: 128/256-bit AES password encryption and safe password removal.

description.p: Official release featuring Visual Page Studio, Smart Target-Size Compressor, Images ⇄ PDF Studio, Multi-Core Batch Queue, and the Lifetime Manifesto.
